mentions.name: XSD Viewer
mentions.description: This web tool makes working with XML Schemas simpler by providing a visual view of schema structure, navigation, and diffing between versions, so users can quickly understand what actually changed between XSD versions.
mentions.problem: Analyzing XSD files to understand regulatory changes in financial reporting was repetitive, painful, and unnecessarily manual.
mentions.audience: People who regularly work with XSDs or XML-based standards
mentions.source_excerpt:
In the past two months I built https://xsdviewer.com
 to make working with XML Schemas simpler: visual structure, navigation, diffing, and faster understanding of what actually changed between versions.
